trend: top fifth of drift_12_1 (the current screen score) within the month's index-union pool

baskets.trend_all: reference: the whole top fifth by drift_12_1 (current screen)
baskets.trend_above_ma50: top fifth, close above its 50-day average (no pullback)
baskets.pullback_ma50: PRIMARY: top fifth, close below its 50-day average
baskets.pullback_1m: top fifth, last-21-session return in the bottom third of the whole pool
baskets.depth_20_plus: top fifth, last-21-session return at or below -20%
baskets.pullback_gap: pullback_ma50 with at least one jump-down day (r - median < -3 robust sigma, sigma from the 252-session window) in the last 21 sessions
baskets.pullback_gentle: pullback_ma50 with no jump-down day in the last 21 sessions

evaluation: Monthly signal at index-membership month ends, next-open entry, equal weight, one-month hold, excess over the equal-weight pool, 0.05% one-way cost times basket turnover; 6-month block bootstrap 95% interval of the monthly net excess. The 3-month horizon is a gross diagnostic (mean excess over the next three monthly holds, no costs).
decision_rule: A basket counts as supported only if its one-month net-excess interval excludes zero AND its annual net excess beats trend_all. Supported baskets go into the screen as signals; the rest are shown, if at all, with a warning. 11 baskets are tested together, so a single marginal pass is treated as weak.
note: US index union only, 2017-2026, in-sample. All baskets are fixed before running and all are reported. Same data, cost and pool as us-factor-v2 and uptrend-check-v1. pullback_ma50 repeats an earlier side diagnostic (uptrend-check-v1, +7.0%/yr gross of turnover cost) as a proper basket with costs.
